method: First-party DevTools WebSocket input injection through EventDispatcher, live node-tree queries, and mirror replay of the window draw list through its selected native renderer. 1280x720 JPEGs are the mirror output; they are not screenshots of the OS compositor.
baseline: button-before.jpg was captured before this typography/theme pass, after the interaction/component changes in bbc3a489.
reference: Read local motrix-mygo-main/theme.go, dashboard.go and widgets.go; native Go/MyGo UI. Referenced typography, surface hierarchy, card radius/shadows and controls; no copied assets.

verified: Cool light canvas and white cards with separated border/shadow
The same story at 200% text scale
Metrics reflow from four cards to two columns
Story scales while the gallery chrome keeps its own scale
Local Menlo family, body 18pt and larger icons
Gallery outside the preview retains its original typography
TextField accepts Guava 设计系统
Save changes increments the custom-token counter to 1
All state-color variants retain vertical padding
Icons remain independently controlled by IconTheme or explicit points
Default menu surface is opaque over labels and buttons
Selection, checkmark and keyboard-highlight styling remain legible

automated_contracts.DesignSystemTests: 7 tests: default/local theme, explicit styles/families, custom extension/metrics, icon replacement/size, scaling once in layout/paint/edit, live open-portal update, scaled menu geometry, real Combobox search/empty/commit
automated_contracts.SystemFontInstanceTests: Real SF variation axes and weight raster coverage; logical optical size and advances remain stable at 1x/2x
automated_contracts.NativeRoundedFillTests: Metal single-sample readback at 1x/1.5x/2x/3x: no halo beyond the physical coverage edge, smooth fractional corner coverage, source alpha is never accumulated
automated_contracts.FontPipelineTests: Layout glyph metrics stay identical before and after bitmap rasterization

limitations: This is visual and interaction evidence, not a quantitative FPS/performance comparison with GPUI Kit or Motrix.
No claim of OS-native text raster pixel identity or acceptance of every component at 200%.
No automatic Windows/Linux system accessibility text-scale subscription; TextScaler currently uses a host-provided linear factor.
The typed Swift theme API does not provide a CSS parser/cascade or complete browser theme parity.
Other platform color glyphs, native accessibility bridges, RTL/locale, variable-height/async data contracts and remaining missing components stay open in gpui-kit-audit.md.
